Footer — Credit Note — Edit

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of credit notes.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to credit notes.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer. This name will appear in dropdown menus when selecting a footer for credit notes.

Content

Enter the HTML content that will appear at the bottom of credit notes. You can include formatting, links, and other HTML elements as needed.

Inactive

Mark this footer as inactive to prevent it from appearing in footer selection dropdowns. Existing credit notes using this footer will not be affected.
